// The correct check's environment, set BEFORE the modules it tests load (ES modules evaluate their imports in order,
// and substrate-gap reads WORKSPACE_ROOT at load): a temp clone root and an isolated gap store, no endpoints.
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { isolateLearnedStateInProcess } from "../resolvers/isolated-gap-store-run.js";

export const ROOT = join(tmpdir(), `mg-log-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`);
export const CLONES = join(ROOT, "clones");
if (!process.env["WORKSPACE_ROOT"]) process.env["WORKSPACE_ROOT"] = ROOT;
isolateLearnedStateInProcess(ROOT);
process.env["VESSELS_CLONE_ROOT"] = CLONES;
process.env["MITOSIS_RUNTIME_DIR"] = CLONES;
process.env["SUBSTRATE_GAP_SKIP_COMPOSE_TRIGGER"] = "1";
process.env["SELF_RESOLVE_ENDPOINT"] = "http://self.test/v2/impulses/resolve";
delete process.env["GAP_STORE_ENDPOINT"];
